name: Bingo Software Co., Ltd.
summary: Bingo Software Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the development and commercialization of cloud computing products. Its core offerings include a suite of powerful cloud platforms: BingoCloudOS, an infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) solution; BingoFuse, designed to support cloud application deployment; BingoLink, an enterprise collaboration platform; BingoInsight, for managing data lakes; and BingoCMP, an IT-as-a-Service (ITaaS) capability platform tailored for businesses. Beyond these foundational cloud products, the company also delivers various specialized software systems, such as those for human resources, supply chain logistics, engineering project management, and contract management. Additionally, it provides mobile office platforms and comprehensive information solutions for business operations. Bingo Software extends its expertise to information and communication technology (ICT) solutions, along with extensive consulting services. These consulting services encompass strategic planning, management process optimization, architectural design, technology selection, custom product development, and system integration, particularly for the operational and maintenance requirements of the rail transit industry. The firm also crafts bespoke solutions, notably for e-government cloud infrastructure and specialized information systems supporting automotive research and development process verification. Serving a diverse clientele, Bingo Software caters to sectors including government, telecommunications, public security, finance, education, and information services, among others. Established in 2003, the company is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
